_comment: Bundled default banner set (portrait / skyscraper, 300x600). Shipped with every Community release so the carousel always has content when the configured feed URL is unreachable (isolated server, blocked outbound, CSP block, timeout). An operator-configured feed uses the same shape and overrides this set when reachable. Creatives are self-contained SVGs in this folder (brand logos embedded); links must stay on an allowed first-party host configured in banners.allowed_hosts or they are stripped.
